name: AutomationDirect EA1-T4CL operator display
summary: EA1-T4CL operator display arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: EA1-T4CL is the drawing identifier for operator display in AutomationDirect's C-more Micro Graphic Panels collection. An operator display presents information and controls to the person operating a machine or process. Its front-panel opening, external bezel and equipment behind the door are separate layout features.

For example, in a packaging-machine door with an operator touchscreen, use the EA1-T4CL reference to coordinate front-face operating position, panel cut-out and rear connectors. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Operator Interface/Cmore Micro Graphic/EA1-T4CL.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep front-face operating position, panel cut-out and rear connectors visible in the layout.
This reference concerns the named EA1-T4CL drawing and its operator display role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
drawingChecklist: Match EA1-T4CL, the native drawing identity and the project equipment schedule.
